Method of Attack: Altering Windows registry app paths to redirect trusted auto-elevated binaries to malicious payloads
Using the Backup and Restore utility (sdclt.exe) to load malicious code without UAC prompts by modifying registry keys for control.exe app path
Attack Vector: Modifying HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\App Paths\control.exe registry key to point to malware
Exploitation of auto-elevation feature in trusted Windows binaries
Indicators of Compromise: New or altered registry entries in HKCU\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\App Paths\control.exe
